facts.fact: HTTP transport performs fatal UTF8 decode then JSON.parse and returns only parsed successful body; successful HTTP status and original lexical JSON bytes are not carried to callV2. HTTP error returns truncated display text. Full method/response identity, duplicate-key and exact integer token validation cannot occur after this parsed-only transport without an earlier validation or raw-carry boundary.

Native pipe bounds bytes but attempts JSON.parse(Buffer.toString utf8) as each chunk arrives and completes upon first parsable JSON. No fatal UTF8/duplicate-key/exact-integer or envelope identity validation is present in this dialNative function. This is a static source observation, not a reproduced native defect or independent acceptance.

classify checks only five status names after optional JSON.parse; it does not bind protocol_version/command_id/client_id/project_id/session_id to the original envelope or validate method-specific complete/reject schemas. It is distinct from new scoped strict CLI response validation.

callV2 accepts COMPLETED/ACKNOWLEDGED/IN_PROGRESS as accepted outcomes. Matching project/session snapshot can change live expectedRevision/writerEpoch without complete-schema validation; writer attach ACK can also clear epoch/update revision. Request accepted vs completion and authority must be reviewed against exact method semantics before any repair; do not call every accepted ACK invalid.

Web classify has same status-only shape. createV2Client may adopt nonnull revision/session_id on COMPLETED or ACK without original-envelope response identity validation. Its actual renderer reachability is not established by this observation; method-table fixture parity is not whole product qualification.

Renderer unwrap accepts COMPLETED and ACK as settled input; readSnapshot adopts result with project-only explicit check. Method-specific pending rendering and stronger response gates need scope review; no renderer operation or GUI has been executed.

future_scope_requirements: Preserve old desktop/preload11+v2-23 channels, native credential isolation and host launch logic; no second scheduler.
Carry bounded original wire bytes/status through real HTTP/native boundary before strict UTF8/duplicate-key/exact integer and frozen complete/error schema validation.
Bind response protocol and command/client/project/session identity including only legitimate create-derived SID before authority/adoption.
Validate current writer own/unexpired snapshot epoch/revision; pending ACK is request acceptance and must retain exact method completion semantics.
Determine actual Web renderer producer reachability before authorizing extra shared paths; do not infer from a table test.
Use current repaired public Host/compiled CLI/Desktop composition and genuine Windows process/UI evidence for formal cases.
